diff:
diff --git a/app/shipping.py b/app/shipping.py
index 14efe99..fa3c97d 100644
--- a/app/shipping.py
+++ b/app/shipping.py
@@ -1,5 +1,14 @@
+import csv
+from collections.abc import Mapping
+
 RATES_CENTS = {"local": 300, "national": 650, "abroad": 1500}
 
 
-def shipping_cents(region: str) -> int:
-    return RATES_CENTS[region]
+def shipping_cents(region: str, rates: Mapping[str, int] | None = None) -> int:
+    return (RATES_CENTS if rates is None else rates)[region]
+
+
+class RatesFile:
+    def __init__(self, path: str) -> None:
+        self.handle = open(path, encoding="utf-8", newline="")
+        self.cents = {row["region"]: int(row["cents"]) for row in csv.DictReader(self.handle)}
diff --git a/tests/test_shipping.py b/tests/test_shipping.py
index 4523c49..e5ed3ce 100644
--- a/tests/test_shipping.py
+++ b/tests/test_shipping.py
@@ -1,5 +1,13 @@
-from app.shipping import shipping_cents
+from app.shipping import RatesFile, shipping_cents
 
 
 def test_shipping_by_region():
     assert shipping_cents("national") == 650
+
+
+def test_shipping_from_a_rates_file(tmp_path):
+    path = tmp_path / "rates.csv"
+    path.write_text("region,cents\nlocal,300\nnational,700\n", encoding="utf-8")
+    rates = RatesFile(str(path))
+    assert rates.cents == {"local": 300, "national": 700}
+    assert shipping_cents("national", rates.cents) == 700
